module.purpose: Builds Pages Router-compatible request and server-side context objects from Next.js App Router headers, cookies, route parameters, and search parameters.
module.summary: This module adapts App Router request data to the legacy Pages Router context shape. It materializes read-only headers and cookies into plain objects protected by mutation-blocking proxies, decodes route parameters for backward compatibility, merges decoded route parameters with search parameters into the query, and exposes an unsupported response object that fails explicitly when accessed.
module.businessContext: Supports legacy request handlers while the application uses Next.js App Router APIs. Failures can break compatibility for pages expecting decoded parameters, legacy request fields, or explicit response behavior.
functions: createProxifiedObject (~L7-13): Protects legacy data objects from unsupported mutation attempts.
buildLegacyHeaders (~L15-19): Converts read-only request headers into a protected plain object.
buildLegacyCookies (~L21-29): Converts request cookies into a protected name-value object.
decodeParams (~L31-48): Decodes scalar and array route parameter values for compatibility.
buildLegacyRequest (~L50-52): Constructs a legacy request object from headers and cookies.
buildLegacyCtx (~L54-78): Constructs a Pages Router-compatible server-side context object.
systemCapabilities: Adapt App Router inputs to legacy request contracts

detail.name: createProxifiedObject
postconditions: Returns a Proxy wrapping the provided object.
Property assignment through the returned proxy throws an Error.
invariants: The wrapped object is not modified by a property assignment through the proxy.
edgeCases: Reading or otherwise accessing existing properties delegates to the wrapped object.
Assigning any property through the proxy throws an Error instead of updating the object.
detail.summary: Wraps a string-valued object in a proxy that permits access while rejecting attempts to modify its properties.

specLiterals.value: You are trying to modify 'headers' or 'cookies', which is not supported in app dir
specLiterals.role: Error message thrown when a property assignment is attempted through the proxy.

specTests.when: Create the proxied object and assign a property through the returned proxy.
specTests.then: The assignment throws an Error with message "You are trying to modify 'headers' or 'cookies', which is not supported in app dir", and the wrapped object remains unchanged.

detail.name: buildLegacyHeaders
preconditions: The headers argument provides an entries() method returning an iterable of key-value pairs.
postconditions: Returns the result of applying createProxifiedObject to an object constructed from all entries returned by headers.entries().
Each header entry contributes a property keyed by its entry key, with duplicate keys resolved according to Object.fromEntries semantics.
invariants: The input headers collection is not mutated.
The returned value is proxified through createProxifiedObject.
edgeCases: An empty headers collection produces an empty object before proxying.
Duplicate header keys are resolved by Object.fromEntries so the last iterable value for a key is retained.
If headers.entries() is missing, throws, or returns a non-iterable value, the resulting runtime error propagates.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Runtime errors from headers.entries(), iteration, Object.fromEntries, or createProxifiedObject propagate to the caller.

detail.summary: Converts the supplied headers collection into an object keyed by header name and wraps that object with the legacy proxy behavior.

specTests.when: buildLegacyHeaders is called with that collection.
specTests.then: It returns the proxified form of an object containing Content-Type: 'application/json' and X-Trace: 'abc'.
It passes an empty object to createProxifiedObject and returns the resulting proxified value.

units.name: buildLegacyCookies

detail.name: buildLegacyCookies
preconditions: The cookies argument provides a getAll() method returning cookie entries with name and value properties.
postconditions: Every returned property corresponds to a cookie name.
Each returned property value is the corresponding cookie value.
If multiple entries have the same name, the value from the last entry wins.
The resulting cookie map is passed through createProxifiedObject before being returned.
invariants: Cookie names are used as the keys of the resulting object.
The resulting map contains string values from the cookie entries.
edgeCases: An empty result from cookies.getAll() produces an empty proxified object.
Duplicate cookie names overwrite earlier values in encounter order.
Cookie entries are reduced into a new accumulator rather than mutating the input collection.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Not specified; failures from an unavailable getAll method or malformed cookie entries propagate.

detail.summary: Builds a proxified cookie object from all cookies returned by the supplied cookie collection. Each cookie is exposed by name with its string value.

specTests.then: The returned proxified object exposes session as "abc" and theme as "dark".
The returned object exposes session as "new".
The returned proxified object has no cookie properties.

units.name: decodeParams

detail.name: decodeParams
preconditions: Each defined parameter value is a URI-encoded string or an array of URI-encoded strings.
postconditions: Each defined scalar parameter value is URI-decoded with decodeURIComponent.
Each defined array parameter value is replaced by an array whose items are URI-decoded in order.
A new accumulator object is returned rather than mutating the input parameter object.
invariants: Array ordering and length are preserved.
The distinction between scalar, array, and undefined values is preserved.
edgeCases: An empty parameter object produces an empty object.
An empty array produces an empty array.
An undefined value remains undefined without URI decoding.
Malformed percent-encoding causes decodeURIComponent to throw a URIError.

raises: URIError from decodeURIComponent when a value contains malformed URI encoding
errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Propagates decodeURIComponent errors; no fallback value is produced.

detail.summary: Decodes URI-encoded parameter values while preserving parameter keys and array structure. Undefined values remain undefined.

specTests.then: The result preserves optional as undefined and empty as an empty array.
The call throws the URIError raised by decodeURIComponent.

units.name: buildLegacyCtx

detail.name: buildLegacyCtx
detail.signature: (headers: Headers, cookies: ReadonlyRequestCookies, params: Params, searchParams: SearchParams) => GetServerSidePropsContext
preconditions: headers, cookies, params, and searchParams are supplied in the shapes expected by their respective adapter helpers.
postconditions: Returns an object with query, params, req, and res properties.
query contains all search parameters followed by decoded route parameters, with decoded route parameters taking precedence on key collisions.
req.headers and req.cookies are produced by the corresponding legacy adapter helpers.
Any property access on res throws an Error indicating that res is unsupported in app dir.
invariants: The returned params value is the decoded form of params.
The query object is created by spreading searchParams first and decoded params second.
The response proxy rejects property reads rather than returning a response value.
edgeCases: When a key exists in both searchParams and decoded params, the decoded params value appears in query.
When params contains percent-encoded values such as "John%20Doe", the corresponding params and query values are decoded for Pages Router compatibility.
Accessing any property on the returned res object throws the documented unsupported-response error.

raises: Error when any property of the returned res proxy is accessed

detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns a context-shaped object: { query: { ...searchParams, ...decodeParams(params) }, params: decodeParams(params), req: { headers: buildLegacyHeaders(headers), cookies: buildLegacyCookies(cookies) }, res: Proxy }.
